description: Fetch one published Vooks document whole, by the URI search_docs returned. Only documents Vooks publishes for agents resolve: this is an allowlist, not a general fetch tool, so it cannot be pointed at an arbitrary URL. Use it when you need the complete text rather than an excerpt.

uri.description: The document URI from search_docs, for example https://www.vooks.com/pricing.md.

name: fetch_doc
title: Fetch a Vooks document
